title: A Holiday in Europe
setting: A train station, a plane, and a small hotel in Rome.

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer)

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

sentences.en: Hana and Sara pack summer clothes for their holiday.
sentences.zh: 哈娜和萨拉为假期收拾夏天的衣服。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) pack T-shirts, shorts and sun hats into two open suitcases.

sentences.en: From the station, a train goes north to France.
sentences.zh: 火车从车站出发，向北开往法国。
sentences.scene_prompt: A long train leaves a busy station, Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) waving from a window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the train leaving the station; 'north' and 'France' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Then a big aeroplane carries them to Rome.
sentences.zh: 然后一架大飞机把他们送到罗马。
sentences.scene_prompt: A big aeroplane flies over the old city of Rome, the round Colosseum below.

sentences.en: They arrive at a small hotel near the river.
sentences.zh: 她们到达河边的一家小旅馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) pull their suitcases up to a small yellow hotel next to a river.

sentences.en: A strong Australian man carries their bags.
sentences.zh: 一位强壮的澳大利亚男人帮她们提包。
sentences.scene_prompt: A strong, sunburnt man in a wide-brimmed bush hat carries two suitcases into the hotel while Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) smile.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a strong man carrying their bags; that he is Australian can't be shown.

sentences.en: His family goes to Africa by boat.
sentences.scene_prompt: The strong man, his wife and two children wave from the deck of a big white boat leaving the harbour.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the family leaving on a boat; 'Africa' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sara writes a postcard about the trip.
sentences.zh: 萨拉写了一张关于这次旅行的明信片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) sits at a café table and writes on a postcard with a picture of the Colosseum.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara writing a postcard; what it says about the trip can't be shown.

sentences.en: Their plane flies east into the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 她们的飞机向东飞去，迎着早晨的太阳。
sentences.scene_prompt: A plane flies over a blue sea towards a big orange sun rising on the horizon.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a plane flying towards the rising sun; 'east' is only suggested by the sunrise.
